{{Quote|They're here! Lords of Atron! They're here already! Give the order to debark. Immediately!|Greezim Trentacal|<ref name="BoG">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''Atron''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Atron system/Legends|Atron system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]].

==Description==
Atron was the crowded [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[House Garonnin]]. Other [[Planet/Legends|planets]], like [[Boro-borosa III]], would send [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to one of Atron's well-known [[Prison/Legends|prisons]]. It was one of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector's]] busiest ports, however, [[House Picutorion]] controlled the nearby planet of [[Tekurr'k]], and undercut Atron by selling the raw materials that Atron lacked the capacity to mine.<ref name="TEA" />

"Lords of Atron" was an exclamation used by [[Greezim Trentacal]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slavemaster]] of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. The planet shared its name with the ''[[Atron's Mistress]]'', a [[Zuraco Cargo Hauler]] owned by Trentacal.<ref name="BoG" />
